_readme: Client-facing content for the /international/ pages: services, prices (USD), scopes, process, labelled portfolio, FAQs and payment-method switches. Validated by build.py (validate_international).

founder.name: Saurabh Kumar
founder.bio: Saurabh Kumar founded Moodily to help businesses build clearer digital journeys, from being found online to educating customers after they buy. He also creates practical AI tutorials on YouTube as AI with Saurabh and wrote the guide Practical AI for Everyday Life & Work. He works from India with clients who prefer to collaborate remotely in English.
founder.channel_note: AI with Saurabh started on 9 September 2026 and passed 2,000 views by 2 October 2026 (founder-reported, not a live counter).

price_note: All prices are in USD unless stated otherwise. Custom projects receive a written scope and quote before work begins. Advertising spend, software subscriptions and other third-party costs are separate unless specifically included.
from_note: "From" prices are starting points: the final price depends on the scope you approve in writing.
timeline_note: Typical Moodily implementation begins after complete information, assets and required access are received. Platform verification may extend the final go-live date.

notices.gbp: Google Business Profile is a free product provided by Google. Moodily charges for setup, optimisation, content and management. You remain the owner; we work through manager access and never ask for your Google password. We can't promise rankings, verification times, calls or revenue.
notices.meta: You keep ownership and control of your Facebook Page, Instagram account and Business Suite. We ask only for the minimum access needed and never for a personal Facebook password.
notices.ads: Advertising spend is paid directly by the client to the advertising platform and is separate from Moodily's service fee. Platforms review ads and accounts on their own timelines. We don't promise return on ad spend, lead volume, sales or revenue.
notices.health: Please do not submit patient or sensitive health information. Our healthcare work covers public-facing information only.

home.a: Service businesses, educators, consultants and software teams that need customers to find them, trust them, get in touch and understand what they offer.

home.q: Do you guarantee rankings, leads or revenue?
home.a: No. Nobody can honestly guarantee those. We commit to the deliverables, timeline and revision rounds in your written scope, and we tell you plainly when something is outside our control.

home.q: Where are you based and how do we work together?
home.a: Moodily is based in India and works remotely in English. Communication is by email or video call; WhatsApp is optional. Times are in India Standard Time (UTC+5:30).

Fixed-price services are confirmed in writing before you pay. Custom projects receive a written scope and quote; work starts after you approve it and pay the deposit. Prices are in USD unless stated otherwise.
Yes, to draft, research and speed up production. Every deliverable is reviewed by a person before you see it, and factual content is checked against its source.
Yes. Tell us in your request and we'll use your NDA or a mutual one before you share anything confidential.

services.q: Who owns the accounts and files?
services.a: You do. Profiles, ad accounts, analytics and domains stay in your name; we work through delegated or manager access. Final deliverables are yours once the project is paid in full.

services.q: Why don't you need my passwords?
services.a: Google, Meta and most platforms let you grant access without sharing a password. That keeps you in control, and you can remove our access at any time.

services.q: What counts as a revision round?
services.a: One round is a single, consolidated set of changes sent together. Each service includes a fixed number of rounds; new requirements or out-of-scope changes are quoted separately.
Usually missing content or access, approvals that take longer than agreed, or platform verification. We'll flag anything that affects the timeline early.

customer-education.q: Do you need access to our product?
customer-education.a: A test or sandbox account is ideal. We don't need production customer data, and we avoid showing real customer information on screen.

customer-education.q: Who checks that tutorials are accurate?
customer-education.a: We check each step against the product before recording, and your subject-matter expert approves scripts at an agreed checkpoint. Nothing is published without your approval.

customer-education.q: Can you update tutorials when the product changes?
customer-education.a: Yes, as a small follow-up project or within a Digital Care plan with a defined monthly scope.

customer-education.q: Can you show our work in your portfolio?
customer-education.a: Only with your written permission. Some deliverables can't be shared because of ownership or confidentiality, and that's fine.

educators.q: I already have content. Do you start from scratch?
educators.a: No. We start from what you have — talks, notes, slides, recordings — and turn it into a clear path: a free resource, a structured course or programme, and onboarding.

educators.q: Do you market or sell the course for us?
educators.a: No. We design and produce the learning assets and the journey around them. Platform, pricing and promotion stay your decisions.

educators.q: Do you need rights to my material?
educators.a: You must own the material or have permission to use it, and we'll ask you to confirm this before we start.

clinics.a: No. This work covers public information only — your profile, website, booking path and educational material. Please do not submit patient or sensitive health information.
Your clinicians. We write and design; anything clinical is approved by your team, and we follow the advertising rules your team confirms for your profession and country.

clinics.q: Have you worked with clinics outside India?
clinics.a: Not yet. The examples on this page are clearly labelled concept demonstrations.
